PRIVACY.SUBTITLE: How we manage and protect your personal fitness data.
PRIVACY.SEC1_DESC: We only collect data necessary to tailor your fitness routines and calculate accurate workout targets.
PRIVACY.SEC2_DESC: Your sensitive profile details are encrypted during transit and stored securely on Elevate cloud infrastructure.
PRIVACY.SEC3_DESC: You can view, edit, or remove your personal data at any moment directly from your profile settings.

HELP.SUBTITLE: Find quick answers or get in touch with our support team.
HELP.FAQ1_Q: How do I update my workout schedule?
HELP.FAQ1_A: You can manage workouts and routines directly from the workouts section on your dashboard.
HELP.FAQ2_Q: Can I change my fitness goal anytime?
HELP.FAQ2_A: Yes! Tap on 'Your Goal' at the top of your Account page to update it whenever you want.
